mapper.select: SELECT equipment_id AS "equipmentId", status AS "status", started_at AS "startedAt" FROM equipment_status_change WHERE ended_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment_status_change SET ended_at = GREATEST(started_at + INTERVAL '1 second', #{endedAt}) WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND ended_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment_status_change (equipment_id, status, started_at) VALUES (#{equipmentId}, #{status}, #{startedAt})
